headline: US Halloween Candy Sales Face Slow Start Amid Cocoa and Living Cost Pressures
summary: High chocolate prices and broader consumer cost-of-living constraints have dampened early seasonal US retail sales for Halloween candy.
why: Cocoa price spikes directly compress confectionery profit margins and test discretionary food consumer price elasticity.

impacts.name: Confectionery Retail
impacts.why: Higher input costs forced price hikes, leading to softer consumer volume demand.
